message.content: Fusion research has yielded remarkable benefits for society beyond energy production. Particle accelerators developed for fusion experiments now power medical treatments like cancer radiation therapy. Superconducting magnets advanced for tokamak reactors are used in MRI machines worldwide. Research into plasma physics has improved our understanding of space weather and solar flares. The iritic nature of this field means constant cross-pollination with other sciences. Materials engineering breakthroughs for reactor walls have led to better industrial coatings. Computational modeling tools created for fusion simulations now aid in climate prediction and drug discovery. These spillover benefits demonstrate fusion's lasting impact.
